name: prox
description: Prox is a knowledge platform for the people who service and operate complex industrial equipment -- field techs, dealers, and operators. The Prox MCP server lets Claude search the tenant's product catalog, inspect any product's knowledge tree, read wiki nodes for diagnostics, parts, and service procedures, and commit edits back to the product graph in the moment. Real dealer- and operator-captured knowledge, not generic web results. The next person who hits the same fault finds the fix waiting for them.

_published_faq.name: How do I add prox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add prox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.useprox.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the prox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: prox provides these MCP tools: list_products, get_product_tree, read_wiki_nodes, and edit_wiki_node.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to prox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to prox in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
prox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
prox is developed by Prox Technologies, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
